format: html

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(kknn)
data(glass)
```



```{r}
parcoord(iris[, 1:4], col = iris$Species)
```



```{r}
parcoord(scale(glass[, -c(1, 11)]), col = glass$Type, var.label = TRUE)

```



```{r}
mua <- 10
mu0 <- 9

a <- numeric(1000)
replicate(1000, (t.test(rnorm(10, mean = mua)+rchisq(10, df = 9), mu = mu0)$p.value)<0.05) |> 
  mean()


a
```
